LESSON: SAUM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.4: Saum

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Saum
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What virtues do Muslims learn from fasting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life
2. appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life
• Model 2: appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life
2. Practise: appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Saum.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What virtues do Muslims learn from fasting?
2. What is the significance of fasting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• apply the virtues acquired from observing saum in day-to-day life
• appreciate observing saum as an act of ibadah

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
